mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through joint labor market dynamics.
failure_condition: The joint effect of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term p-value exceeds 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a concurrent increase in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, the joint rise in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction signal falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate output and profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it triggers central bank rate hikes that reduce real equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), elevated unemployment signals weak consumer demand and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC for UNRATE level signal falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent increase in real GDP growth and housing starts indicates strong aggregate demand that supports corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through joint demand dynamics.
failure_condition: The joint rise in GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or interaction term p-value exceeds 0.05.
